authwp-desc: Authenticate MediaWiki users against a WordPress installation, with username change request support.
authwp-registration-disabled: Registration through this wiki is disabled. Please register on the main website.
authwp-staff-only: Your WordPress role does not have access to this wiki.
authwp-unknown-user: We couldn't find an account with that username. Please sign in with the username or email address you use on menhirsfate.com.
authwp-bridge-error: The login service is temporarily unavailable. Please try again in a few minutes, and contact the team if the problem persists.
authwp-rename-mustlogin: You must be logged in to request a username change.
authwp-rename-request-intro: Your current username is '''$1'''. Use this form to request a new wiki username. An administrator will review your request.
authwp-rename-already-pending: You already have a pending request to change your name to '''$1''' (submitted $2). Please wait for an administrator to review it.
authwp-rename-same: That is already your current username.
authwp-rename-request-success: Your request to change your username to '''$1''' has been submitted. An administrator will review it shortly.
authwp-rename-no-requests: There are no username change requests.
authwp-rename-not-found: Request not found or already resolved.
authwp-rename-no-renameuser: The RenameUser extension is not installed. Cannot process renames.
authwp-rename-failed: The rename operation failed. Check the server logs for details.
authwp-rename-approved-success: Username change approved: '''$1''' has been renamed to '''$2'''. The WordPress login mapping has been saved.
authwp-rename-denied-success: Username change request from '''$1''' to '''$2''' has been denied.
authwp-sso-button-label: Log in with your Menhirs Fate account
authwp-sso-button-help: You will be sent to menhirsfate.com to sign in, including two-factor authentication if you have it enabled, and returned here automatically.
authwp-sso-misconfigured: Single sign-on is not configured correctly on this wiki. Please contact an administrator.
authwp-sso-failed: Single sign-on did not complete. You were not signed in.
authwp-sso-state-mismatch: This sign-in link is no longer valid. This usually means it was already used, it expired, or the sign-in was started in a different browser session.
authwp-sso-retry: Please return to [[Special:UserLogin|the login page]] and try again.
